import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_arxiv_page(start=0):
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start}&max_results=25&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    return web_fetch(url=url)

# Namespaces from arXiv XML response
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

def is_multimodal_rag_paper(title, summary):
    text = f"{title} {summary}".lower()
    multimodal_terms = [
        'multimodal', 'vision', 'image', 'video', 'audio', 'speech',
        'cross-modal', 'crossmodal', 'vlm', 'vision-language',
        'multi-modal', 'graph', 'tabular', 'document understanding'
    ]
    # Check for multimodal relevance combined with RAG
    return any(term in text for term in multimodal_terms)

papers_data = []
page_start = 0
max_pages_to_check = 15  # Prevent infinite loop

while len(papers_data) < 5 and page_start < max_pages_to_check * 25:
    response = fetch_arxiv_page(page_start)
    if response.get('status') != 200:
        print(f'Error fetching page starting at {page_start}')
        break
    
    root = ET.fromstring(response['content'])
    
    for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
        title_elem = entry.find('atom:title', ns)
        summary_elem = entry.find('atom:summary', ns)
        updated_elem = entry.find('atom:updated', ns)
        id_elem = entry.find('atom:id', ns)
        
        if None in (title_elem, summary_elem, updated_elem, id_elem):
            continue
        
        title = title_elem.text.strip()
        summary = ' '.join(summary_elem.text.strip().split())  # Normalize whitespace
        updated = updated_elem.text.strip()[:10]  # Just date part
        arxiv_id = id_elem.text.strip()
        
        # Get abstract link (HTML page)
        abstract_link = None
        for link_elem in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
            if link_elem.get('rel') == 'alternate' and link_elem.get('type') == 'text/html':
                abstract_link = link_elem.get('href')
                break
        
        if not abstract_link:
            continue
        
        if not is_multimodal_rag_paper(title, summary):
            continue
        
        papers_data.append({
            'title': title,
            'summary': summary,
            'date': updated,
            'link': abstract_link,
            'arxiv_id': arxiv_id
        })
        if len(papers_data) >= 5:
            break
    
    page_start += 25

# Generate markdown comparison table
def generate_markdown_table(papers):
    header = "| # | Title | Published | Key Summary |\n|---|---|---|---|\n"
    rows = []
    for i, p in enumerate(papers[:5], 1):
        # Truncate summary to ~120 chars for readability
        truncated_summary = p['summary'][:120] + "..." if len(p['summary']) > 120 else p['summary']
        # Escape pipe characters
        safe_title = p['title'].replace('|', '\\|')
        safe_summary = truncated_summary.replace('|', '\\|')
        rows.append(f"| {i} | {safe_title} | {p['date']} | {safe_summary} |")
    return header + "\n".join(rows) + "\n"

markdown_table = generate_markdown_table(papers_data)

# Save to papers.md
with open('papers.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as md_file:
    md_file.write(markdown_table)

print(f"Successfully found and saved {len(papers_data[:5])} multimodal RAG papers to papers.md")
